question: Neuraminidase of the influenza virus:

options.opa: It is found inside the capsid and is released after entering the cell.
options.opb: Its function is to facilitate the encapsulation of genetic material.
options.opc: It is one of the spicules of the envelope.
options.ope: It facilitates the adsorption of the virus to the cell.

analysis: Neuraminidase of the influenza virus is an enzyme found on the surface of the virus. Its main function is to facilitate the release of newly formed virus particles from infected cells and to aid in the spread of the virus within the host. It does this by cleaving sialic acid residues on the surface of host cells, allowing the virus to escape and infect new cells.
